title: Quantum Gromov-Hausdorff Convergence for Extensions of $C^*$-Algebras
summary: We investigate the lifting of quantum Gromov-Hausdorff convergence through Toeplitz type $C^*$-algebra extensions by stable ideals in the framework of noncommutative metric geometry. Working with the spectral metric space construction of Hawkins and Zacharias (Comm. Math. Phys. 350 (2017), 475-506), we consider a sequence of complete sub-operator systems of the quotient or the unital $C^*$-algebra underlying the stable ideal, converging in the quantum Gromov-Hausdorff distance.
